query:
-- Doublons par pubchem_cid
SELECT pubchem_cid, COUNT(*) as nb, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ',') as ids, GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' | ') as noms
FROM molecules
WHERE pubchem_cid IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pubchem_cid
HAVING nb > 1
ORDER BY nb DESC
LIMIT 20;
